# ZeroC.LMDB

This package provides the [LMDB] static libraries for both debug and release builds.

## Source

The libraries are built from the unmodified upstream LMDB sources. The MSBuild project, nuspec and targets that
produce this package are in [the lmdb directory], and the URL and SHA-256 checksum of the upstream source archive
are in [sources.json].

[the lmdb directory]: https://github.com/zeroc-ice/ice/tree/main/packaging/windows/third-party/lmdb
[sources.json]: https://github.com/zeroc-ice/ice/blob/main/packaging/windows/third-party/sources.json
[LMDB]: https://www.symas.com/mdb/
